title: Epic Creator Output
description: Output schema for the epic creator agent. Converts an approved PRD, impact assessment, and dependency graph into a grounded, dependency-ordered set of business-capability epics with full PRD-requirement traceability.

execution_summary.description: Plain-text summary: workflow_execution_id, epic count, PRD requirement coverage, key sequencing/priority decisions, self-check findings, open_questions, tools invoked, blob storage location

epics.description: Business-capability epics, grounded in PRD/impact-assessment/dependency-graph content, ordered by dependency (foundational nodes before dependent nodes)

traceability_matrix.description: Generated directly from every epic's requirements_used — one entry per FR-NNN/NFR that appears in at least one epic. Must never diverge from requirements_used.

open_questions.description: Plain-language unresolved items — unmappable PRD requirements, dependency-graph nodes that don't resolve to an epic, ambiguous grounding, split candidates

Epic.description: A business capability epic. Must represent a business capability, NOT a technical layer.

title.description: Business capability title, <=10 words, verb-first, domain language from the PRD — not a technical layer

description.description: What this epic delivers and why, grounded in prd.md/impact-assessment.md content

business_value.description: Must cite a specific PRD requirement or carried-forward vision theme, not a generic statement like 'improves the business'

priority.description: Derived from the PRD's own requirement ordering/priority markers — never invented

requirements_used.description: Every FR-NNN/NFR this epic covers. Every PRD requirement must appear in at least one epic's requirements_used, or be recorded in open_questions.

confidence.description: Self-assessed grounding confidence for this epic

reasoning.description: Why this epic exists, why this scope, why this priority

rationale.description: Why this criterion matters to the epic

source.description: Grounding citation resolving to real prd.md / impact-assessment.md / dependency_graph.json content, e.g. 'prd.md § FR-001' — never fabricated

folder_name.description: The folder_name parameter supplied at runtime

blob_storage_url.description: URL returned by the blob storage writer tool after saving the epic set
